column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the bonds of Pleiades” is rendered “the cluster,” and “the chains of Orion” “the belt.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַזָּרוֹת (“the constellations”) is transliterated “Mazzaroth,” and “the Bear” is “the Great Bear.”
Close to the Hebrew; the rare word בַּטֻּחוֹת (“inward parts”) is rendered “the mind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who will tilt the waterskins” is rendered “who can pour out the bottles of heaven.”
Close to the Hebrew; וְחַיַּת (“the life, appetite”) is rendered “the appetite.”
